title: Extreme Flood Warning - Rampur
message: Water level rising rapidly near eastern embankment. Immediate relocation recommended for residents of Rampur.

title: Shelter Capacity Alert - Triveniganj
message: Triveniganj High School Camp is nearing full capacity. Only 40 seats remaining.

title: Animal Rescue Needed - Bishanpur
message: 12 buffalo stranded on rooftop. Rescue team required urgently.

title: Road Blocked - Madhepura-Purnea Highway
message: Highway submerged under 3 feet water. Avoid route. Use alternate path via Singheshwar.

title: Heavy Rainfall Alert - Supaul District
message: Extremely heavy rainfall recorded (112 mm). Flood risk critical in low-lying areas.

title: Medical Camp Open - Chhatapur
message: Emergency medical desk operational at Chhatapur Block Relief Centre. Free treatment available.

title: Evacuation Order - Jorgama
message: All residents of Jorgama advised to evacuate immediately to nearest relief camp.

title: Cattle Camp Setup - Supaul
message: Temporary cattle camp opened near Supaul College. Livestock can be shifted there.

title: Water Level Rising - Udakishunganj
message: River water crossed danger mark. Low-lying colonies at high risk.

title: Relief Material Arrived - Murliganj
message: Food packets, drinking water and tarpaulins available at Murliganj High School Camp.

title: Power Outage - Alamnagar
message: Electricity supply disrupted due to flooding. Restoration may take 48 hours.

title: Missing Persons Desk - Madhepura Stadium
message: Help desk for missing persons operational at Madhepura Stadium Camp.

title: Boat Rescue Ongoing - Pipra
message: NDRF boats deployed for rescue in Pipra village. Assemble at raised mound near pond.

title: Contamination Warning - Drinking Water
message: Do not use handpump water in flooded zones. Use only packaged or boiled water.

title: All Clear - Basantpur Sector
message: Water level receding in Basantpur. Residents may return after official clearance.
